g.text: Not owned by a product. A plan's products are
the products of the features it includes:
tier_rank orders plans within their ladder:
upgrade and downgrade only compare plans
Not owned by a product either: its features
quota: maximum of a metered feature.
empty on a metered one = unlimited.
Only where the add-on adds something:
an unmetered feature the plan lacks,
or a metered quota (added to the plan's).
unique index — s: single column · c: composite
solid line: within the subsystem · dashed: another subsystem
